{{Expand Italian|Roberto Cervellati}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=November 2026}}
'''Roberto Cervellati''' (13 November 1933 – 7 November 2026) was an Italian physicist and explorer.<ref>[https://www.rainews.it/articoli/2026/11/roma-fisico-muore-travolto-da-monopattino-caccia-al-pirata-della-strada-ad83d502-b065-43c6-9811-82897901a2c3.html Muore travolto da monopattino, è caccia al pirata della strada] {{in lang|it}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Cervellati was a researcher at ENEA. He was a leading figure in Italian scientific expeditions to Antarctica. He participated in seven expeditions to the polar continent, also as head of mission.<ref name=RAInews>{{cite web|access-date=8 November 2026 |title=Muore travolto da monopattino, è caccia al pirata della strada |url=https://www.rainews.it/articoli/2026/11/roma-fisico-muore-travolto-da-monopattino-caccia-al-pirata-della-strada-ad83d502-b065-43c6-9811-82897901a2c3.html |website=www.rainews.it}}<!-- auto-translated from Italian by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>

As part of the National Antarctic Research Program, Cervellati held scientific coordination and operational responsibilities.<ref name=RAInews/>

From 1992 to 2006, Cervellati represented Italy on the Scientific Committee for Research in Antarctica (SCAR). In those years, he also directed the sector involved in the creation of the continent's gazetteer.<ref name=RAInews/>

Cervellati was struck in a hit-and-run traffic incident in [[Rome]], on 6 November 2026. He died in hospital the following day, at the age of 92.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-11-09 |title=Rome: Physicist hit and killed by a scooter, 51-year-old man who turned himself in reported |url=https://www.agenzianova.com/en/news/Rome%3A-51-year-old-man-who-turned-himself-in-was-hit-and-killed-by-a-scooter./ |access-date=2026-11-09 |website=Agenzia Nova |language=en}}</ref>
